additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0481278
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312569868/08
Charger ID / Serial No.:
NKqOgs
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Knowing that no errors are currently live, it has been noticed that the charger terminal is no longer operational. The charger screen displays the following error:
"Terminal candidate list empty."
This is unexpected. Please try the same troubleshooting steps.
This error can be caused by network-related issues, such as a defective or disconnected network cable, a faulty network switch, or power supply problems with the payment terminal. It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured.
Additionally, ensure all connections are secure. Swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help determine if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows:
Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.body:
Bonjour Franck,
Le TPE ne fonctionne toujours pas sur cette borne et aucune transaction n’est remontée. La dernière date du
16/02/2026
. En regardant un peu plus bas dans les logs, on retrouve la même erreur
« Terminal candidate list empty »
à
7h43
:
Dans la capture d’écran que tu as partagée, on voit également l’erreur suivante :
mqtt: pt/partialreversal/response {"status":"error","message":"Could not convert receipt number to TA number"}.
La borne semble tenter en boucle de traiter des
partial reversals
. Les logs indiquent que certaines transactions sont relancées en continu alors que les paiements ont déjà été finalisés et clôturés depuis plusieurs jours. Par exemple :
Requested ZVT Partial-Reversal 06 23: amount 5000, currency EUR, receipt 2563
Requested ZVT Partial-Reversal 06 23: amount 5000, currency EUR, receipt 2558
Après vérification dans Payone, les reçus
2563
et
2558
sont pourtant déjà clôturés. Malgré cela, la borne continue d’envoyer ces requêtes depuis cette date.
Tu aurais une idée de la cause possible de ce problème ?
Tiens-moi également au courant si un remplacement du TPE ou du CorA10 est nécessaire.
Merci,
Bien à toi,
